title: Entitlement key set, entitlement-key-set/1 (DEC-0085)
description: The issuer's signing keys for entitlement/1 documents, under a monotonic revision, signed by the issuer's root key (which a verifier pins at installation and which signs nothing else) over the RFC 8785 form of the set without sig (the register's entitlement-key-set/1, DEC-0063). A key is added with a window that overlaps the old one; a revoked kid refuses every entitlement it signed.

revision.description: Rises with every set the root signs; a verifier refuses a lower revision than the one it applied, and the same revision with other bytes.

issuedAt.description: At least one key's window holds it (FAC-SEM-116).

notAfter.description: After notBefore (FAC-SEM-116). An entitlement verifies under this key only when its issuedAt is at or after notBefore and before notAfter.

keys.description: The signing keys: each kid once, never the root's kid, at least one valid at issuedAt (FAC-SEM-116).

revoked.description: Kids revoked: absent from keys (FAC-SEM-116), and every entitlement one of them signed is refused (key-revoked).

kid.description: The root key's kid, as the verifier pinned it.

sig.description: The root key's Ed25519 signature (64 bytes, base64url without padding) over the UTF-8 RFC 8785 form of the set without sig.

ed25519X.description: A 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding, canonical (the last character's two spare bits zero). Never a key of small order (DEC-0045, CT-29): the enum lists libsodium's seven encodings with the sign bit clear and set.
